scope: Exploratory local Docker/k6 observations, not performance acceptance.

plan.controls: Two repetitions of identical baseline executables for Maximus, Hyper and Axum on plain plaintext and TLS H2 error, before candidates.
plan.decision: Exploratory campaign; no automatic performance acceptance. Zero functional failures and source/size gates required. Report every paired delta and range. Any repeatable adverse evidence prevents acceptance, even below a noise-screen threshold. Same-binary control instability, inconsistent paired gains or contradictory evidence leaves conclusions unqualified. Three samples and partially balanced order cannot prove universal absence of regressions. A promising candidate requires a fresh confirmation stage with balanced source order and the complete matrix against both references. Never normalize candidate deltas by comparator deltas.
plan.reference: Original b5bb664 production source with current qualification harness; known rejected-CONNECT defect, valid workloads only.
